plugins.name: room
plugins.description: SLP room on ZCode: the out-of-band mailbox (MCP post/read, addressed by seat), the seat registry, the append-only closure-loop ledger, and the Supervisor arming skill (/slp) with the */2 heartbeat fallback, backed by the workspace room-state directory. The wrapper CLI (room doctor/lead/heartbeat/tail) ships alongside in cli/.
